items.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-10-07
items.q: The interviewee does not mention Wills; the interviewer mentions 'Wills was playing a drummer on a boat with me' and 'Will's took his place', but the interviewee provides no personal connection or confirmation of knowing Wills.

ctx.x: Nelson, George Nelson George Nelson was saxophone player, George Nelson was saxophone player, and Nelson Jones was a trombone player.
And a drummer then would be, uh, well Wills was playing a drummer on a boat with me. with me. Yeah, Will's came on a boat. So, let's see if I got that straight or not.

Chani was there first on the boat? Yeah. And then who took Chani's place? Will's took his place? Yeah, Will's took his place. What's Will's full name? I don't know Will's full name. And this Reuben Oliver, what were you saying about him? Reuben Oliver, does he live near here or something? No, does he know what he's talking about?
